alt: Before: a sparse, open clearing with bare ground, scattered leaves and little understory, bordered by trees and a dense leafy shrub on the right. Plant diversity and ground cover are lacking.
During: a group of volunteers bends and stands across a cleared, mulched woodland site, planting. Straw mulch patches and bare soil lie among grass, with trees in the background.
After: a narrow dirt path winds through lush green grasses and shrubs under tall, leafy trees. Dense native vegetation now covers the site, which was bare before.
